why: 15 November 2026 (collection 1052): s2/source_gate.py compares every published figure with its publisher before each publish. 'hold' = any FAIL stops the publish (the live site keeps the last good build) and the phone is told; 'warn' = report only. It starts in 'warn' because the errors the 15 November audit found were still live when it was merged; it goes to 'hold' in a separate change once a build passes it.
